claims.text: Outperforms native engine and state-of-the-art LQOs.
claims.baseline_control: Native PostgreSQL, Bao/Balsa; LLMSteer only JOB→CEB reproducible format
claims.selection_vs_test: Best plan per query over50 rounds used Table1; each target query feeds memory.
claims.result_denominator: Table1 CEB best overall LS8B60.04%, filtered65.05%; Stack LS3B overall40.10%, LSG8B filtered93.57%. Bao Stack overall76.90%/Balsa67.17%, so blanket LQO superiority false outside qualified metric.
counterevidence: Accelerated-only filtered metric excludes regressions; cross-model/round selected extrema; table overall Stack favors existing LQOs.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Author-reported substantial native-engine savings and CEB wins; not all-model/all-workload LQO dominance.

claims.text: Self-evolving RAG drives continuous performance improvement.

claims.baseline_control: NR reference-off variant; first-iteration fine-tuning ablation
claims.selection_vs_test: No frozen-memory or own-history-off matched50-round arm; same queries guide optimization and score.
claims.result_denominator: Table3 CEB LSG3B overall50.13% vs NR41.26% and JO24.81%; LS8B reaches RET0.41 reported. No independent retained evaluation.
counterevidence: Raw best-of-search/noise and cumulative compute unseparated
NR still self-evolves on own best
claims.allowed_conclusion: Task-level iterative query tuning benefit with some reference contribution; not certified independent retained improvement.

claims.text: Generalizes across workloads, drift and DBMS without extra tuning.
claims.setting: JOB offline to Stack online; alternating databases; MySQL hint translation; TPC-DS with GPT-o3-mini
claims.baseline_control: Native engine; dynamic Bao; static reference scenarios
claims.selection_vs_test: No target offline fine-tuning; runtime target feedback available in all later rounds
